notes.title: 0.21.0 Buffing Towers
notes.content:
We are getting close to the release and have added some more features that will improve upon the gameplay. That is mostly because of great feedback from our community that helps us improve the game! Thank you so much! <3

- Each class now has two unique towers
- Class towers can buff other towers
- Removed OpenGL for Linux
- Added Linux build for Playtest
- Updated the tutorial with images
- Added more boss abilities
- Added hazards on more planets
- Various bug-fixes

notes.title: 0.19.0 It's hard
notes.content:
Changed resource nodes to be fewer and bigger
 Removed building platforms as a spendable resource
 Supply drops will now land on a specific location on each planet
 Added flying enemies which can only be targeted by specific towers
 Some enemies types can attack towers
 Visually improved classes to make them more unique
 Visually improved towers to make them more unique
 Various UI/UX fixes
 Friendly fire can be deactivated
 Added dynamic reticules
 Added a hard mode
 Added a nuke

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
Fixed issue if Gersemi dies while player is entangled
Fixed raven magic attack direction
Fixed towers not being able to attack large enemies/bosses
Fixed issue with multiple enemy totems spawning in the same place
Fixed issue with shotgun ultimate destroying towers outside its range
Made a few smaller tweaks

notes.title: 0.18.0 Chieftain
notes.content:
Linked energy bars with the class rank system
Ultimate ranged attack is unlocked at class rank 3
A few enemies in each wave are now chieftains, a stronger version of the enemy
Building platforms no longer drop from enemies, but are given to the player as a reward after killing a full wave
Added a few more enemy totems
Rock giants split in two on death
Maggots explode on death
Introduced simple boss phases 
Tweaked environments
